svg.text: Worked examples: classify each component, then count
Lobes show only the faces used to form bonds (phases omitted). Green dashed: bond forming; grey: bond breaking.
Sources: CM3121 L14 p.4–7, 24–25; L15 p.6–8, 32; L16 p.6, 21–24. Ketene (c): the C=C reacts antarafacially, helped by the orthogonal C=O π (Clayden p.898–899).
